info.faqA1: List your items, browse others' items, and propose swaps. AI helps match compatible items based on category, value, and preferences.
info.faqA2: Yes! The basic plan is free with unlimited swaps. Premium tiers offer additional features like priority matching, map pins, and more tokens.
info.faqA3: All messages are moderated, public meeting spots are recommended, and both parties must confirm each step of the exchange process.
info.faqQ4: What if the other person doesn't show up?
info.faqA4: You can cancel the swap at any stage. Reputation scores reflect reliability, so unreliable users get lower match priority.
info.faqA5: Our scoring algorithm considers 9 factors: category match, intent compatibility, flexibility, perceived value, location, bundle acceptance, subcategory, tag overlap, and sentimental value.

info.guideStep1Text: Tógann sé 2 nóiméad. Ní bheidh ort ach ríomhphost a chur ar fáil. Gan cairt de dhíth.
info.guideStep2Title: Cuir rud ar fáil ar an bhfreagra ar mhian leat a mhalartú
info.guideStep2Text: Tóg 3-5 grianghraf ar ardchaighdeán, scríobh cur síos ionraic, abair cad atá uait ar ais. Faigheann míreanna le grianghrafanna 4x níos mó togra.

info.guideStep5Text: Soiléir na sonraí trí ghairmchomhrá: cruinn aghaidh ar aghaidh nó úsáid curier. Dearbhaigh an fhéinmhalartú agus fág rátáil.

legal.privacyLegalBasisText: Tá an phróiseáil bunaithe ar: do thoilíochán (cruthú cuntas, glacadh le fianáin), feidhmíonn an conradh (éadáil a éasúchán), agus spéis dhlisteanach (slándáil an ardáin, cosc ar chalaois).

legal.privacyRetentionText: Coimeádtar sonraí cuntas agus do chuntas gníomhach. Ar dhílscriosadh, baintear gach sonra pearsanta laistigh de 30 lá. D'fhéadfaí staitisticí malartaithe anaithnide a choimeád le haghaidh anailíse an ardáin.

legal.cookiesAnalyticsText: Cabhraíonn fianáin anailíse roghnach linn tuiscint a fháil ar phatrúin úsáide: cé na leathanaigh is tóirthinní, conas a dhéanann úsáideoirí nascleanúint, agus cá ndéanann siad fadhbanna a aimsiú. about.title: Maidir le Swaply
about.subtitle: Ardán tógtha ar smaoineamh simplí: ní bhásaíonn rudaí, gluaiseanns siad ar aghaidh.
about.storyP1: I built Swaply because I had a drawer full of perfectly good things I no longer used — and I was tired of selling them for pennies or letting them collect dust.
about.storyP2: The idea is simple: if I have something you no longer need, and you have something I no longer need — why involve money?
about.storyP3: Swaply is where you swap directly, with no commissions, no price haggling, no PayPal, no bank transfers. Just two items and two people who need what the other has.
about.step1Title: Cuir leis an méid ar mhaith leat a thabhairt
about.step1Text: Grianghraif, cur síos, an méid ar mhaith leat i ngeall air.
about.step2Title: Faigh an méid ar mhaith leat
about.step2Text: Brabhsáil nó foluain-mheaitseáil — déanann an algartam an obair throm.
about.step3Text: Comhrá díreach, aontaigh ar na sonraí, agus déan babhtála.
about.whyTitle: Cén fáth Swaply seachas margadh clasaiceach?
about.whoQuote: Swaply is built by Petru Melinte from Jurilovca, Romania. We're not a corporation. We're a real project, built on the belief that the barter economy is more human than the consumer economy.
about.techDescription: Tógadh Swaply le Next.js, React, Supabase, agus Tailwind CSS. Fógraithe ar Vercel, íocaigí trí Stripe. Scríobhadh an t-iomlán cód ag forbróir amháin — gan fhoireann, gan infheisteoirí, ach gean agus caifé.
about.ctaSub: Saor in aisce. Gan chárta de dhíth. Gan coimisiúin.
about.metaDescription: The story behind Swaply — the platform for swapping objects without money.
